perItemFindings.label: def:regular-wald-variance
perItemFindings.one_line: The planned `sigmaAt H j` uses zero-based `singularValues (Fin.mk j ...)`, but consumers treat it as one-based: at r0=1, `sigmaAt H (r0+1) < sigmaAt H r0` tests 0 < σ₂ rather than σ₂ < σ₁, so the rank-one baseline takes the fallback 0 branch.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S4's `sigmaAt` wrapper and every consumer as one-based: map rank index j to singularValues index j-1, with the qbar+1 convention returning 0. Then retain the core condition `sigmaAt H (r0+1) < sigmaAt H r0`; this restores the strict-gap and Wald-variance definitions.
